title: Concept: Overly open CORS (apache) — review required
description: In apache, Headers+sets+Access-Control-Allow-Origins+["']?* lets foreign origins read responses. Wildcard origins combine dangerously with credentialed requests. The remedy is an explicit origin list (an expression-mapped origin).
applicability: apache API servers and middleware; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-origin data theft where credentials apply; MEDIUM severity.
